desc: 雾瓷浅场与砚青墨场交替，竖向铜栅细线、雾银空碟与空白表盘承载卖点
leaf: 带顶部触控面板与定时表盘的家用电饭煲
name: 竖向铜栅空白表盘电饭煲款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表与详情首屏一眼抓点击，用深场铜栅与空胶囊把核心主张压在第一秒。
shots.textZone: top-left headline band plus two pill slots stacked along the left edge

shots.intent: 把一机多用的卖点摊成信息图阵列，让买家一眼扫完功能面。
shots.textZone: headline strip across the top, one bracketed label slot closing each lower disc

shots.intent: 放大守锅与糊底这两个真实摩擦，让买家先把痛点认出来。
shots.textZone: one bracketed caption slot at the foot of each panel

shots.intent: 用一张方格坐标上的两条曲线讲清升温机制差别，代替不可验证的数字。
shots.textZone: headline slot above the sheet and one bracketed caption slot under it

shots.intent: 用一组样板薄片证明做工与表面质感，机制可视化但不落到材质命名。
shots.textZone: blank label bars beside the plates, one bracketed slot reading 「{callout_8}」

shots.intent: 用微距证明面板与缝隙的工艺，同时把屏显与按键全部留在空白状态。
把定时免看管这件抽象事转成一个可读的表盘符号，降低理解成本。
shots.textZone: one bracketed caption slot set below the ring centre

shots.intent: 把产品放回真实厨房台面，让买家代入日常一顿饭的动线。
用一桌家常饭承接出饭效果，把电器价值落到餐桌上完成自证。
把规格疑虑一次收掉，用空参数格与端点尺寸线保留版面但不写任何实测值。
回到首屏的深场铜栅完成收口，用空按钮位承接行动而不编造优惠。
shots.textZone: one pill button slot beside the product and one blank badge frame above it

style.backgroundSystem: two fields alternating screen by screen, a matte porcelain-grey plane #DFE3E2 and an ink-teal graphite depth #2B3134, each screened with evenly spaced vertical bronze slats #9C7A55 used only as hairlines; one mid-tone silver field #C3C7C4 for split and table screens; no third backdrop, no gradient wash, no bloom
style.direction: porcelain-grey graphite kitchen-appliance commerce, slat-screen plus blank-dial infographic detail page
style.iconSystem: solid brushed-silver blank discs each carrying one diagonal slash and no glyph, a twelve-tick blank dial ring with two unmarked hands, empty pill slots, empty three-column parameter cells with grey label lines only, dimension rules ending in plain ticks with no digits; no check marks, no badge artwork, no numerals, no units, no scale graduations
style.lightingSystem: cool soft studio light, large front-left softbox with a low fill card, one thin bronze rim on the far edge, soft contact shadow only, no harsh speculars, no warm tungsten cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium kitchen-appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte porcelain-grey field #DFE3E2, ink-teal graphite depth #2B3134, pale stone silver #C3C7C4 and one desaturated bronze hairline accent #9C7A55 used only as thin vertical slats and rules; cool soft studio lighting with a large front-left softbox, low fill card, thin bronze rim and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with a rule-bracket label device; solid brushed-silver blank icon discs carrying one diagonal slash and no glyph, plus a twelve-tick blank dial ring, empty pill slots and empty three-column parameter cells; real surfaces stay matte porcelain or pale stone; stable slight 3/4 product volume and lid-forward orientation; every display, screen, touch key, dial, axis and dimension line stays blank with no readout, no graduations and no units; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no numerals or certification artwork.
noDrift: no digits, readouts, units or graduations drawn on any screen, dial, axis, dimension line or parameter cell
no gradient glow, bloom or gold-plating effects on the bronze hairlines
style.presentationRules: the product keeps one consistent slight 3/4 volume and lid-forward orientation across the set, never cropped, never floating without a contact shadow; every screen, display, touch key and dial stays blank with no readout, no graduations and no icons
style.surfaceSystem: matte porcelain-grey counter #DFE3E2 and pale stone silver #C3C7C4, plus a low turned pedestal disc in pale silver on the graphite field #2B3134; edges finished with a single hairline bronze rule #9C7A55
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline block parked in a declared negative-space band, one thin rule-bracket under each label, in-image Chinese always rendered from placeholders and never copied from any source page
